title: 第34章：东北杨家

第34章：东北杨家-《道士下山之749局》

胡九郎并没有接触过出马仙，但是作为龙虎山道人中的“佼佼者”、“高材生”，自然也知道出马仙的名头。

李二牛如此严肃认真，胡九郎也是不由得一笑。

“行，我知道了！”

李二牛迟疑了一下。

“其实还有一件事，你可能不知道……杨童并不是去这边的分局，而是回老家了！”

胡九郎脸上的笑容瞬间僵住，眼底闪过一丝诧异，停下脚步。

“你说什么？杨童没去分局，是回老家了？”

李二牛点了点头，压低声音。

“没错，青峰镇往南三十里，就是杨童的老家杨家坳，她根本不是去分局汇报工作。因为分局不需要她汇报什么工作，电话联系即可，而且魔都分局和这边的分局也早已经取得联系！”

胡九郎眉头紧锁，若有所思。

“她为什么要隐瞒？按理说回老家这种事，没必要瞒着我们。”

“这就涉及到杨家的旧事了，杨家祖籍就在东北，几十年前，杨家和我们出马仙供奉的五仙结下了不小的矛盾。具体是什么矛盾，我也不太清楚，只知道当年闹得很大，杨家损失惨重，后来就渐渐淡出了这个圈子，杨童是在外地长大的，并加入的749局。”

胡九郎想起上次杨童也简短的说过杨家，但是她对此似乎颇为讳莫，不愿意多说关于杨家的事情。

“你的意思是，杨童这次回老家，可能和当年杨家与五仙的矛盾有关？在东北她有可能会被五仙记恨，遇到危险？”

“正是，而且黑风岭是五仙经常出没的地方，那里的阴气重，五仙的根基也在那边。杨家和五仙的矛盾没解开，杨童只要踏入黑风岭范围，就会被五仙的气息感应到，到时候别说帮我们找莫奇卫，她自身都难保。她虽然当时还不知道要去黑风岭，但是也许是想要知道如何避免和五仙产生冲突的办法！”

胡九郎沉默下来，脑海里浮现出杨童离开时的模样，她神色平静，没有丝毫异常，想来是怕众人担心，才故意谎称去分局。

胡九郎心头泛起一丝担忧，这杨家和阴尘阁有纠葛，跟五仙又有矛盾，这杨家以前到底是干什么？

“先不说这个了，杨童既然不想说，我们也别追问，反正她说明天能赶回来，我们先做好前往黑风岭的准备。”

Hu Jiulang has never come into contact with Chuma Xian, but as a "outstanding" and "top student" among the Taoists of Longhu Mountain, he naturally knows the name of Chuma Xian.

Li Erniu was so serious that Hu Jiulang couldn't help but smile.

"Okay, I get it!"

Li Erniu hesitated.

"Actually, there is one more thing that you may not know... Yang Tong is not going to the branch here, but back to his hometown!"

The smile on Hu Jiulang's face froze for an instant, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes, and he stopped.

"What did you say? Yang Tong didn't go to the branch. He went back to his hometown?"

Li Erniu nodded and lowered his voice.

"That's right. Thirty miles south of Qingfeng Town is Yangtong's hometown, Yangjia'ao. She didn't go to the branch to report to the branch at all. Because the branch doesn't need her to report any work, just contact her by phone, and the Magic City branch has already been in contact with the branch here!"

Hu Jiulang frowned, thoughtfully.

"Why should she hide it? Logically speaking, there is no need to hide things like returning home from us."

"This involves the old affairs of the Yang family. The Yang family's ancestral home is in the Northeast. Decades ago, the Yang family had a lot of conflicts with the Five Immortals we worshiped as Immortals. I don't know exactly what the conflict was. I only know that there was a big commotion and the Yang family suffered heavy losses. Later, they gradually faded out of the circle. Yang Tong grew up in other places and joined the 749 Bureau."

Hu Jiulang remembered that Yang Tong briefly talked about the Yang family last time, but she seemed to be quite secretive about it and was unwilling to say more about the Yang family.

"You mean, Yang Tong's return to her hometown this time may be related to the conflict between the Yang family and the Five Immortals? Is it possible that she will be hated by the Five Immortals in the Northeast and be in danger?"

"Exactly, and Black Wind Ridge is a place where the Five Immortals often hang out. The Yin Qi there is strong, and the Five Immortals' roots are there. The conflict between the Yang family and the Five Immortals has not been resolved. As long as Yang Tong steps into the Black Wind Ridge, she will be sensed by the Five Immortals' aura. Let alone helping us find Mo Qiwei, she will not be able to protect herself. Although she didn't know she was going to Black Wind Ridge at the time, she may want to know how to avoid conflict with the Five Immortals!"

Hu Jiulang fell silent, and the image of Yang Tong when she left appeared in his mind. Her expression was calm, and there was nothing unusual about her. It seemed that he was afraid that everyone would be worried, so he deliberately lied about going to the branch.

A trace of worry arose in Hu Jiulang's heart. The Yang family had entanglements with the Yinchen Pavilion and conflicts with the Five Immortals. What did the Yang family do before?

"Let's not talk about this for now. Since Yang Tong doesn't want to talk about it, let's not ask further. Anyway, she said that she can come back tomorrow. Let's make preparations to go to Heifeng Ridge."
